name: concept
leaves: an idea the owner picked, docs/concept.md, docs/art.md and an art proof of that idea that passed 3 critics

steps.do: Research: 3 references (one award winner), the category's cliches, unusual angles

Ideation with the owner, before any art: one open question about the product moment, then 3-5 distinct ideas (each: what a visitor tells a friend, how it's made in code, the cliche it avoids, the risk), the owner picks or reshapes one
Concept card for the picked idea: the signature moment beat by beat, sections, copy angle
Art proof of the picked idea, code first (three.js/R3F shaders, canvas, SVG, GSAP)
3 fresh blind critics on the art proof, at once; on FAIL fix the named gaps, at most 2 rounds, then council or back to c2
Origin and licence of every asset
Council only if the art proof fails 2 rounds and the owner wants to keep the idea
